title: RAG Hallucination Failure Mode
text: Hallucinations in retrieval-augmented generation often happen when the model answers beyond the retrieved evidence or when retrieval misses the necessary chunk entirely.

title: Grounding Strategy
text: A practical mitigation is to score each answer sentence against the retrieved context and mark unsupported claims before returning the final response.

title: Auto-correction Loop
text: Auto-correction can re-query on unsupported claims, pull tighter evidence, and regenerate a shorter answer constrained to grounded chunks.

title: Confidence API
text: A production API should return the answer, a hallucination score, evidence used, claim-level verdicts, and a corrected answer when risk is high.

title: Dashboard Value
text: A dashboard becomes persuasive when it highlights unsupported claims in red, shows the evidence source, and compares confidence before and after correction.

title: Free MVP Constraint
text: A free MVP can use FastAPI, Streamlit, sentence-transformers, and FAISS locally without paying for hosted vector databases or proprietary language models.
